headline: Singapore Pledges S$45 Million to Accelerate AI Use in Advanced Manufacturing
summary: Singapore announced a S$45 million initiative through EnterpriseSG to co-fund the deployment of artificial intelligence solutions for small and medium-sized manufacturers.
why: Advanced manufacturing represents a cornerstone of Singapore's export economy, and state grants accelerate productivity enhancements among industrial suppliers.

impacts.name: Singapore Manufacturing
impacts.why: State co-funding lowers adoption costs for SMEs integrating automated and intelligent production systems.
